chunks.heading: Overview
chunks.text: The devices resource represents a single paired device. Every device belongs to exactly one household and has a type, room assignment, and current state.

chunks.heading: PATCH /v1/devices/{device_id}
chunks.text:
curl -X PATCH https://api.nimbus.example/v1/devices/dev_7f2a \
  -d state=unlocked
# any subset of settable device fields may be included

chunks.heading: Rate limiting headers
chunks.text:
Every API response includes:
X-RateLimit-Limit: 300
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 271
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1735689600
